In some Muslim communities, it is also used as a name for a newly converted Muslim, signifying their newfound freedom from the chains of disbelief.

The name serves as a constant reminder to strive towards a pure and righteous life, free from the bondage of sin and darkness. The name Farees can be seen as a call to purify one's heart and mind, and to walk towards the path of guidance and enlightenment.
